snippet.title: Voidbloom — Official Gameplay Trailer | Free Browser Roguelite
snippet.description:
Play VOIDBLOOM free in your browser:
https://playvoidbloom.com/

VOIDBLOOM is a free neon survival roguelite that launches instantly in desktop and mobile browsers. No download or account is required to begin.

Move your vessel while its weapons attack automatically, choose from three upgrades whenever you level up, create different weapon and passive builds, and survive increasingly dangerous enemy swarms.

Bosses arrive throughout each run, leading to the VOIDMOTHER at 12 minutes. Defeating it unlocks an endlessly scaling stage rather than immediately ending the run.

Optional accounts add cloud saving, permanent progression, rankings, friends, and live multiplayer.

PLAY VOIDBLOOM
https://playvoidbloom.com/

Official website: https://playvoidbloom.com/
How to play: https://playvoidbloom.com/how-to-play/
Press kit: https://playvoidbloom.com/press/

#VOIDBLOOM #IndieGame #Roguelite
